<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914005_theRebbe_415" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914005_theRebbe_415__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Just as in divine service, even though the service of Torah and mitzvos is bounded, it also contains the aspect of the non-gradual, and the leap of teshuvah is above even that, so too in reward, beyond the three levels of the worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah in Gan Eden, there is the reward of going from strength to strength, but even these elevations are only illumination and revelation, and afterward will come the drawing down of the Essence that is above the concept of ascents and descents, to the point of a day that is entirely Shabbos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, just as it is regarding divine service,</t>
    <t s="1">that although the service of Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="2">(in their own right)</t>
    <t s="3">is within limitation, it also contains the aspect of the non-gradual</t>
    <t s="4">(which is effected through the service of teshuvah),</t>
    <t s="5">and there is also the matter of the leap of teshuvah, which is above even the aspect of the non-gradual that is in the service of Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="6">so too is it regarding the reward,</t>
    <t s="7">that in addition to the three levels</t>
    <t s="8">(Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah)</t>
    <t s="9">in Gan Eden, which are levels of gradual descent,</t>
    <t s="10">the reward of "they shall go from strength to strength"</t>
    <t s="11">is of ascents that are beyond comparison.</t>
    <t s="12">But even these ascents are only illumination and revelation,</t>
    <t s="13">and afterward will be the drawing down of the Essence, which is above the matter of ascents and descents,</t>
    <t s="14">to the point that it cannot be said of this that it is above the matter of ascents, for it is not in the category of ascent and descent,</t>
    <t s="15">but rather a day that is entirely Shabbos.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This is the meaning of "Return, O Israel" said in the haftarah of Shabbos Teshuvah, for the service of Shabbos Teshuvah rectifies all the Shabbosos of the past year and also affects all the Shabbosos of the coming year, and just as in fear all levels are connected, so too in teshuvah, even the lowest level is connected to the highest, leading to the ultimate redemption and the rebuilding of the Third Beis HaMikdash.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is "Return, O Israel," etc., which is said in the haftarah of Shabbos Teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="1">that the service of Shabbos Teshuvah rectifies all the Shabbosos of the past year and also affects all the Shabbosos of the coming year.</t>
    <t s="2">And as explained in the writings of the Arizal,</t>
    <t s="3">that the first day</t>
    <t s="4">(of the week)</t>
    <t s="5">of the seven days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur rectifies all the days of the first day of the past year,</t>
    <t s="6">and likewise regarding the second day, etc., until the day of Shabbos.</t>
    <t s="7">And just as it is regarding the rectification of the past year,</t>
    <t s="8">so too is it regarding the coming year,</t>
    <t s="9">for the mitzvah of teshuvah from the Torah is that he should no longer return to folly, etc., and not transgress again, etc.,</t>
    <t s="10">meaning a good acceptance for the future,</t>
    <t s="11">until</t>
    <t s="12">[in the language of the Rambam]</t>
    <t s="13">the Knower of mysteries testifies concerning him that he will never return to this sin again</t>
    <t s="14">(slightly missing).</t>
    <t s="15">And just as in the matter of fear it is known that although there are many levels,</t>
    <t s="16">fear of punishment,</t>
    <t s="17">fear of G-d,</t>
    <t s="18">fear of the Exalted, etc., up to the level of fear as it is in the aspect of the point of the yud,</t>
    <t s="19">nevertheless all the levels of fear are connected and bound with each other,</t>
    <t s="20">so too is it regarding teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="21">that even teshuvah in the most lowly manner is connected and bound with the most supernal level of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="22">up to the level of teshuvah of "and the spirit shall return to G-d who gave it,"</t>
    <t s="23">as explained in Likkutei Torah on this portion.</t>
    <t s="24">And this is what is said on Shabbos Teshuvah: "Return, O Israel, etc., and let us render the bulls of our lips,"</t>
    <t s="25">that through the teshuvah of Shabbos Teshuvah, which affects all the Shabbosos of the year, they come to the level of "and let us render the bulls of our lips," which is a very exalted level, as above,</t>
    <t s="26">and in the language of the Rambam,</t>
    <t s="27">"Israel do teshuvah and immediately they are redeemed, and the Third Beis HaMikdash will be built, and there 'we will make</t>
    <t s="28">before You the obligatory offerings as Your will commands,'"</t>
    <t s="29">speedily, indeed.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
